newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pique defends Endesa in its bid process.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pique defends Endesa in its bid process.

text.p: Spanish Industry Minister Josep Pique defended on Monday the procedure followed by electricity firm Endesa in its offer to buy two electricity firms, Sevillana de Electricidad and Fecsa.
In a television interview, Pique said Endesa behaved correctly when the Spanish Stock Market Commission (CNMV) requested information on the deals it planned with the two firms.
"Now the CNMV and Economy Minister have to take the decision," he said.
On December 18, the CNMV filed a suit for "a very serious infraction" against the state electricity firm for failing to inform the authority in October of its plans.
The CNMV also filed a suit against Endesa's chairman Feliciano Fuster and its finance director Jose Luis Palomo.
Endesa has denied that it violated the stock market commission's rules.
Pique said a leak of the news that was only officially made public several days later did not come out from his ministry and he said he hopes that CNMV will make responsibilities clear.
